definitions.series: one N image x one strength (High/Low): five P images in a fixed order; P = k uses the first k
definitions.P4_minus_P1: one-N input with 4 P images minus the one with 1 P image, same series and placement; mean over series
definitions.all_P_5_minus_2_images: All-P control: 5-image minus 2-image All-P input of the same series and placement
definitions.slope_P1_to_P4: least-squares slope over P = 1..4 within a series (x centred at 2.5), mean over series
definitions.difference_in_differences: (one-N margin P4 - P1) - (All-P margin 5 - 2 images), within series and placement
definitions.H2_high_minus_low: High minus Low one-N input of the same N image, placement and P count; mean over N images
definitions.H2_slope_of_difference: least-squares slope over P = 1..4 of (High - Low) within an N image
definitions.series_weighting: High and Low series weigh equally; every N image contributes one series of each strength
definitions.false_yes: one-N input with parsed answer Yes; unparsed answers count as not Yes and are reported separately
definitions.margin_bf16: logit_margin: bf16 generation logits of 'Yes' and 'No' (sensitivity)
definitions.bootstrap: 95% percentile cluster bootstrap; replicate estimate = draw-count-weighted mean over contrast units
definitions.exclusion_rule: a contrast unit is dropped if any of its inputs is excluded (pairs stay intact)
definitions.sign_consistency: an input is sign-consistent if the bf16 margin is > 0 with answer Yes or < 0 with answer No; ties and unparsed answers are excluded

hypotheses.H0: Minimum / Product-AND over fixed per-image evidence: adding P images to an input that keeps the same N image does not increase the Yes margin or the False-Yes rate.
hypotheses.H1: Positive Evidence Accumulation: adding P images increases the Yes margin and the False-Yes rate.
hypotheses.H2: Secondary: for the same N image, placement and image count, the High-P series gives a higher False-Yes rate and margin than the Low-P series (same image counts, different evidence strength).
hypotheses.caveat: H0's prediction assumes that the evidence of the existing images and the decision criterion stay fixed. An increase is reported as a disagreement with fixed-evidence AND models, not as a rejection of every AND computation.

primary.contrast: P = 4 minus P = 1 within the same series (same N image, same strength, same placement), averaged over series
primary.trend: secondary: least-squares slope of the False-Yes rate over P = 1..4

co_primary_margin.outcome: primary margin (fp32 variant) on one-N inputs
co_primary_margin.contrast: P = 4 minus P = 1 within series, by placement

minimum_effect.confirmed_by: user, before any STEP 5-2 model output
minimum_effect.rationale: STEP 5-1 (exploratory): top vs bottom tercile of mean P evidence differed by +0.156 in False-Yes rate and +0.59 in margin; +1 SD of P evidence went with +0.31 margin. The STEP 4 one-N False-Yes rate was 0.274. 0.05 is about one third of the tercile contrast and 18% of the baseline rate; 0.25 logit is two bf16 margin steps (0.125), 0.22 SD of the STEP 4 margin and close to the +1 SD association. 5-1 measured mean P evidence, 5-2 varies the number of P images, so these are practical lower bounds rather than predictions.

statistics.resampling_unit: N image ID (anchor); all series and inputs of a drawn N image enter together
statistics.sensitivity: class-level cluster bootstrap (P images are reused across N images only within a class); used for the robust label

model_predictions.note: Qualitative predictions written before the data. P effect = one-N change P4 - P1; DiD as defined above.

rows.model: AND over fixed per-image evidence (Minimum / Product)

rows.high_minus_low: present and grows with the P count

rows.model: Mean over all images (N share diluted)
General Yes tendency with image count

rule.per_placement_supported: point estimate >= minimum effect AND N-image cluster bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0
rule.robust_label: A supported placement is labelled 'robust support' only if the class-level cluster bootstrap 95% CI lower bound is also > 0; otherwise 'support (cross-class generalization uncertain)'.
rule.per_placement_no_meaningful_increase: N-image cluster bootstrap 95% CI upper bound < minimum effect

false_yes.rule: Report placement-specific alternatives with the exploratory results: N-first = distance between N and the question grows; N-last = the N representation can change with preceding P images.

margin_co_primary.rule: Report placement-specific alternatives with the exploratory results: N-first = distance between N and the question grows; N-last = the N representation can change with preceding P images.

decision.note: H1 is decided by the False-Yes rule; the margin is reported with the same rule as co-primary.

summary.description: Primary, trend, difference-in-differences and H2 margin contrasts with the bf16 'Yes'/'No' margin.
Contrasts without inputs whose bf16 margin sign disagrees with the answer (ties and unparsed included).
Contrasts without N-first inputs above the cosine-distance criterion, with the pairs they belong to.

exploratory.note: Exploratory, not part of any decision. z_N: frozen STEP 4 z_i probe (per class) on the N image's pooled features in one-N inputs. h_q: frozen STEP 4 readouts for positions 1-3, trained on 3-image inputs; inputs with 2, 4 or 5 images are off-distribution, so h_q scores are descriptive only.
